opportunities.name: Supplier quote comparison email
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes in different currencies to USD on xe.com, look up the supplier city's local time on timeanddate.com, then email procurement with both USD amounts, the cheaper currency and the supplier's local time.
steps: Open the xe.com currency converter (dismiss the cookie banner if shown)
Set the 'from' currency to quote currency A, enter amount A, and note the USD result
Set the 'from' currency to quote currency B, enter amount B, and note the USD result
Open timeanddate.com World Clock, search for the supplier city and note the local time
Open New message: To = procurement@example.com, Subject = 'Quotes: <product>'
Body: '<amtA> <curA> = <usdA> USD, <amtB> <curB> = <usdB> USD, cheaper: <cur>. Supplier time in <city>: <time> <tz>'

instances.values: CNC enclosures: 12500 EUR -> 13,993.90 USD, 1950000 JPY -> 12,315.30 USD; Osaka; procurement@example.com
Shipping boxes: 8200 GBP -> 10,862.40 USD, 780000 INR -> 8,209.32 USD; Pune; procurement@example.com
Partial, no email seen: 64000 INR, then CNY 64000 / 14500 conversions

opportunities.name: Company account brief from EDGAR + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, find the latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR full-text search, get HQ, employee count and CEO from Wikipedia, and email an account brief.
opportunities.site: efts.sec.gov EDGAR search + en.wikipedia.org + webmail compose
steps: On EDGAR advanced search, clear the company field and type the ticker; pick the matching company suggestion
Search, open the Form filter and select 10-K; note the latest filed date
On Wikipedia, search the company name and open its article; note HQ, employees and CEO from the infobox
Open New message: To = dana@example.com, Subject = 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Body: '<Company>: HQ <city>, <n> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.'

instances.values: Snowflake (SNOW): HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy, 10-K 2026-03-20
Datadog (DDOG): HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, CEO Olivier Pomel, 10-K 2026-02-18
HubSpot (HUBS): partial, EDGAR search and Form filter only

opportunities.name: Cross-office meeting sync email
opportunities.description: Use the timeanddate.com Time Zone Converter to get the offset between two cities, check the second country's public holidays for the target month, and email ops the offset and dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com > Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B, then note the hour difference
Go to Calendar > Holidays, open the country of city B and note the public holidays in the target month
Open New message: To = ops@example.com, Subject = 'Sync: <cityA> / <cityB>, <Month>'
Body: '<cityB> is <offset> ahead from <cityA>. Avoid: <holiday dates>.'

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India, October: +12h30, avoid Oct 2 and Oct 20
New York / Berlin, Germany, December: +6h, avoid Dec 25 and Dec 26
